segments.text: I said you can do it.
Choose whatever you want, I'm buying today.
That's great!
I'll pick the wine.
Thank you for the meal.
It's cold because of the air conditioner, cover up.
You may spill something, it'll be a problem if you do.
You didn't wear enough clothes today.
One second...
You can only reveal one part at a time.
Today, just your skin.
I'm going to the lady's room.
Let's go together.
Me too.
Me too.
Who are they wearing so little for?
What's wrong with women?
It's not as if no one knows she has a nice body, the only one who needs to know is me.
Must she show everything to feel satisfied?
The thought of other guys looking drives me nuts.
I want to beat up every guy who looks at Seo Yi Soo on the streets.
How do you think I feel?
Me Ah Ri is young and pretty.
All four of us had lovers and were at the best period in our lives,
but we were still men, male.
Yeah, one second.
However, although we couldn't stand when our women showed some skin,
it was a welcome sight on anyone else.
Inconsistent and ironic,
that was the type of male we were.
Episode 19
Why?
What is it?
What happened?
What is it?
What happened?
Just sit.
What made you call us out this early?
Park Min Sook wants a divorce.
This is what you called us for?
I told you to leave it for tomorrow if it wasn't urgent.
It's for real this time!
She didn't say, "We're getting a divorce,"
she said, "Let's get a divorce, I'm begging you.
It's the first time since we got married that I saw my wife crying so much.
It was probably only the first time you saw.
You think that was the only time she cried?
What did you do this time?
We're not going to stay still this time either.
Let's stop doing this, don't turn into a punk middle-aged man!
Why are you all doing this?
I really didn't do anything wrong.
I put on my pajamas and was about to go to bed when she suddenly brought it up.
I was completely shocked too!
Did she drink?
A glass of wine?
Then she must've said it while drunk!
No!
She was completely serious about it!
And she didn't throw me out, she packed her own bags and left.
She's ignoring all my calls and messages!
We wanted to as well!
You called us out this early over nothing!
Hurry and crawl back in!
Let's go.
Where are you going?
I have a really bad feeling about this.
Are you guys really going to be like this?
She's threatened to divorce you ten thousand times,
I've never seen a person like that actually get divorced.
I'll go see your wife tomorrow or the day after,
so get some sleep.
I'm going.
You need to give it some time.
We're still just going through a phase.
I made it uncomfortable for you guys too, sorry.
Stop talking nonsense.
Come on.
I need to put on a face pack.
I'm meeting Teacher Seo's colleagues later.
You look fine without it.
When I hear this song in the future, I think I'm going to think of today.
I can make it even more memorable.
If I don't let you go home today, what are you going to do?
Today, I don't want to let Seo Yi Soo go home.
Thank you.
Let's get on the next one.
Let's just get on the one before.
What floor is it?
Seventeen.
I avoided the Residence Hotel on purpose,
but I guess you two had the same idea.
I guess we both did something unnecessary.
Stop joking around.
Kim Do Jin said that he had a meeting here,
I just came here to see him off.
A business meeting.
Good luck and do well, fighting!
Business this late at night?
He's a foreign client so he's still not used to the time difference.
Hurry, go.
She might get the impression that I come to hotels with men.
Hurry.
I'm already under the impression, so stop fretting,
and if it's a happy moment, grab it.
Life is short, and love passes quickly.
A woman needs to work hard to be happy.
It's for real this time!
She didn't say, "We're getting a divorce,"
she said, "Let's get a divorce, I'm begging you.
Ask her to have a drink with you, and send me a message with the room number.
Mrs. Park, I have business to attend to.
You're going to use business as an excuse?
There's no other way,
my girlfriend is an ethics teacher, after all.
If you'll just be with her for an hour, I'll come find her later.
He's really here for business.
I guess it's easy to get the wrong impression when a couple
comes here together.
But we're definitely not.
Alright, then.
Where are you right now?
I just saw your wife.
Do you know who she's with right now?
Who?
At this late hour, at a hotel...
Hotel?
She's with someone she definitely shouldn't be with.
Which hotel is it?
Divorce?
Yes.
I'm going to do it, divorce.
I can't sink any further than this.
He says it's not and I still doubt him.
I doubt him even when I know it's not true.
When he didn't care, it just made me angry.
But now that he's treating me well,
it drives me crazy wondering if he's trying to hide something.
I don't know anymore.
I don't know whether I'm broken, or fine.
I know what that is.
It isn't a sickness.
You've been in a one-sided love all this time, haven't you?
You never allowed him to do anything for you,
you always did it for him first.
Bigger, and more often.
Then recently, you've been so unbelievably happy, right?
'Cause you were suddenly being loved.
I have a bit of experience with one-sided loves.
A person who is only used to giving love, when they receive it,
first become suspicious.
"Why are they doing this?
So suddenly, why?"
But in my opinion, it didn't come out of the blue,
perhaps he finally found his opportunity.
An opportunity to give you love.
It must be Kim Do Jin, one moment.
What are you doing here?
Why aren't you picking up your phone?
Rok has been looking for you a lot.
Why were you looking for me?
So that you could sign the divorce papers?
Are you really going to do this?
Do you really want a divorce?
Do you?
You don't want to?
I just asked you, do you want to get a divorce?
If I want a divorce, are you going to agree to it?
It's not as if you ever listened to my opinion.
Then let's do it.
Divorce is possible even when just one person wants it,
unlike marriage.
Sign both the first and the back page.
The second page is in regards to dividing assets.
I'll give you a third of the money I've earned since we got married.
Are you really going to do this?
Not enough?
Park Min Sook!
I don't want to go to court and waste time and money fighting you.
Sign it.
Mrs. Park...
Do you really want to get divorced that badly?
Fine!
Then I'll do it!
You're going this far 'cause you don't want to live with me,
so I guess I should get out of your life.
Let's get the divorce.
Satisfied?
Come on...
I don't need the money, you can keep all of it!
I only liked you with all your money,
I have no intention of taking just the money without you.
I'm leaving.
Lee Jung Rok, Rok, hey!
Are you alright?
Sorry, but I'd like to be alone.
I'm tired.
Did he leave?
What do we do?
First I need to find Jung Rok.
She just did this on the spur of the moment, right?
The one who's the most angry is me.
We're at a hotel, but look at what we've gotten ourselves into.
Seriously...
Don't get so serious.
There are couples who say, "I love you" dramatically like that.
Seo Yi Soo is only allowed to worry about me, who's worried about his friend.
Let's go.
Yeah, where are you?
Really?
Jung Rok really signed it?
Yeah.
He signed the divorce papers right in front of me.
Crazy bastard, he should've called me then.
In that situation, he couldn't.
So where is he right now?
I don't know.
He disappeared before I could get to him,
like something from a Hong Kong movie.
But when she offered to divide assets, he refused and ripped up the document.
That's love, right?
It is.
With her temper and his behavior,
If those two really wanted to separate, they would've done it a long time ago.
He's not picking up.
This bastard, is he off somewhere drinking and getting into trouble?
Soon Taek, fruit platter for table three.
Yes.
What.
What?
What are you doing there?
The chef didn't come in today, so I'm working in the kitchen.
I heard you signed the divorce papers.
Yeah.
Yeah?
Considering the way I've lived, it was inevitable that it would happen one day.
Although I had no idea that would be today.
Mark the calendar,
next year on this day, I'm going to have a drink.
Chop steak for table seven.
You heard, right?
I'm busy.
Console me separately, at home, through text message.
Go.
He's really not okay.
It's all burned.
It's your last summer vacation before you become seniors.
Don't spend your entire short summer studying.
Go on trips with your parents, and if you can't,
at least go on walks with them.
Watch a lot of good movies, and read lots of good books.
And those who have girlfriends should break up,
when you go to college, there are plenty of prettier girls.
Really?
I need to go to college!
You did well this semester.
I can hear you swallowing.
Then, let's eat.
Thank you for the food!
What are you going to do over summer break?
I'm thinking of taking on a part-time job.
Job?
Your dad doesn't give you an allowance?
He does, but when I turn twenty, I want to go on a trip, to England.
Why England?
Eric Clapton, Jeff Beck, and Jimmy Page are all from there.
Sounds cool.
Are you getting along with your dad?
We're getting closer.
I've changed his name from ahjusshi to Korean dad, too.
What about you?
I'm also getting closer to him.
Shall we get closer as well?
Our first meeting wasn't all that bad.
Yes, we were accomplices.
I didn't even know whose car it was back then.
You're pretty when you smile.
What is it?
I didn't come here to see you.
Let's go.
Have a nice summer.
Wait.
You two are friends?
So, have you figured out how to make money through stocks?
I've figured out a way to make 100 million won.
Really?
In order to make 100 million won,
you need 200 million.
And how are you supposed to make that 200 million?
It should be possible with 400 million.
Just eat your chicken.
How am I supposed to make 400 million?
I don't even have a part-time job right now.
"Fried Chicken wants you!"
We are looking for hard-working and passionate employees
Doesn't your dad make enough money?
I'm the head of my family.
Hand it over.
My dad does make enough money,
but he gives me 30 thousand won a week.
That's plenty!
Obviously you've never experienced any hardships growing up.
Experience preferred, must have a clean-cut appearance
They prefer people with experience.
I don't think you'll do.
They said you have to be clean-cut.
You won't do.
I have plenty of experience with part-time jobs.
I learn everything quickly.
I'm 187cm tall and am good-looking.
Not only am I good-looking, but I'm well proportioned as well.
If you get to know me, I'm a kind kid.
Just with one glance you can tell I'm a kind kid.
I have a lot of popularity with girls.
I already have those high school girls in my hand.
Then shall I get a hold of high school boys?
I'm a youth who knows what a joke is.
I've gotten the application and information packet.
I want to enter an art school.
And your major?
Fashion design.
I'm pretty good with the sewing machine.
You can say I'm quite talented with it.
When my brother finds out I'm not going to graduate school and re-enrolling,
he'll be furious.
He doesn't know I dropped out halfway.
First off, concentrate on getting admitted.
Leave everything else to me.
Sit here.
It's to commemorate your climb up the mountain,
although you're still far from the top.
Climbing a mountain?
There's a mountain that is the most difficult to climb in this world,
he's called Im Tae San.
And the most beautiful echo lives on that mountain.
Echo meaning...
Me Ah Ri?
Yeah, you.
You're wearing the bracelet!
What about your ring?
I took it off.
When?
Were you really sad?
I don't have the confidence to answer that question truthfully.
Alright, I won't ask.
'Cause I know how you feel now.
What should we do today?
Sorry, I have plans today.
I'll take you back.
Then you should've given me this gift tomorrow.
Who are you going to meet?
Who did you come here as?
Choi Yoon?
Or Im Me Ah Ri's boyfriend.
I came as Me Ah Ri's boyfriend.
Then I have nothing to say to you, go.
You...
what are you...
I'll make Me Ah Ri happy.
Get up.
I'll make sure that Me Ah Ri never cries again.
I said get up!
Give Me Ah Ri to me.
You bastard...
I'll always remember this moment.
It was a love I acquired through many hardships,
and I'll remember that until I die.
I said get up!
How can you go this far with me?
How can you kneel, you bastard!
What am I supposed to do?
What do you want me to do?
I'll pay you back every day of my life.
Every day, I'll give you my thanks.
Give Me Ah Ri to me.
The same for me.
Did Yoon get back in?
I talked to him on the way here,
he was on his way to see Rok's wife.
Guess he's still able to work.
Did you meet Yoon?
Why?
Did you lose the battle?
These two think love is everything...
I hit him.
Who?
Yoon?
I keep wondering whether this was always a losing game.
Even before the game has ended, when you wonder,
"I guess I'm going to lose this game,"
what are you supposed to do?
Even when you know you're going to lose,
you still do your best.
It's Yoon and Me Ah Ri's life.
You've done all you could do.
You've opposed them,
warned them of possible future hardships,
and even spoke to them about the possibility of separation.
Now, leave their lives in their own hands.
And let's just watch over them.
What are you doing here?
Rumors of our separation were flying around the hotel.
I came to get some things while moving to another hotel.
What about you?
What are you doing here?
About those assets,
I've thought about it, and I couldn't give it up.
Of course not.
Fine, I'll give you that third.
Fine then.
Grab it.
What?
If you want to get a divorce, grab it.
You said 1/3 of our assets, right?
I'm going to divide and take 1/3 of everything in this house.
What?
You'll watch to the nose.
I'll watch from the left eye.
You want to sit on your left cheek or right?
Make your decision within three minutes.
You want hot water or cold water?
Stop playing around.
Hot water for you, cold for me.
You know ice is on the cold side, right?
You're really going to cut this?
Yeah!
Move, you'll get hurt.
You were home.
It's good that you came.
Please stop this person who may soon become my ex-husband.
Jaesooshi?
She's just Park Min Sook.
But what happened to your face?
You don't need to know.
What is that?
You don't need to know either.
You just worry about suing that bastard who hit you.
I'll take care of my divorce my way.
Please advise him that the divorce is carried out according to the law,
not however he wants,
whether as his friend or my lawyer.
Well, then.
That woman...
Look here, Park Min Sook!
I'm only taking what is rightfully mine!
Is there a problem with that?
Look here, ex-wife, Park Min Sook.
I forgot to put the dividing tape on the scroll.
Open the door so I can do that.
I haven't marked the scroll!
Ex-wife Park Min Sook!
Teach, Do Jin-oppa is here.
May I come in?
And you, don't come anywhere near this room.
I was on my way out anyway.
Teach, I'm leaving.
Bye.
Why do you bother having a phone?
Are you going to continue dropping in unexpectedly?
This is why I told you to move near my place.
Has something good happened?
Why are you prettying yourself?
Since it's vacation, I'm thinking about becoming a bit more risque.
Up to what?
How much?
You have no say over it.
You can't even use your hands, yet you say such provocative things.
Don't do it.
This woman never lets me do anything.
Do I?
Fine then, do it.
What do you think I'm going to do?
What do you think I'm anticipating?
Aren't you an ethics teacher?
It's summer vacation.
And I'm more risque today than yesterday.
It's Seo Yi Soo's private life, don't you like it?
I like it a lot,
and usually such luck means there is some kind of trap.
There's no trap.
I really wanted to seduce you.
By any chance, did I do something wrong?
You're so easy.
Don't be nervous, I'm not going to eat you up.
I'm going crazy because of Seo Yi Soo.
What perfect timing.
One moment.
Yeah, Yoon.
Are you with Yi Soo right now?
Yeah.
Then just listen.
Okay.
That day when we saw those men with Yi Soo at the cafe,
I gave them my business card, right?
Yeah?
I guess she found out about it,
Yi Soo's mother called me.
She wants to see you.
Really?
I heard that Yi Soo had some brothers,
though according to memory I only gave birth to Yi Soo.
Seo Yi Soo seemed to be in a difficult position,
I'm sorry if it caused you any discomfort.
There's no need to be sorry.
You also helped me.
I'm the one who is sorry,
those boys must've acted like punks.
Well we acted in the same manner.
Thank you.
It was not something I could prevent.
What is it you do?
I'm a director at an architectural firm,
my friend and I are partners.
I'm 41 years old.
Single?
Or divorced?
I'm single, but...
I have a 19 year old son.
And Yi Soo knows about this?
Yes, she found out a few days ago.
I'm sorry.
Don't worry.
I'm a mother who has no right to object to whatever Yi Soo does.
Your name?
Kim Do Jin.
Kim Do Jin.
How did you come here?
Why?
I called him out.
I wanted to see either one of you, but you're both here.
Sit.
What do you think you're doing?
Who are you to order him to come?
Get up.
First, just sit down.
Are you crazy?
Why are you sitting here like this?
When I gave birth to you, I was in labor for forty hours.
I may have no right to object,
but I believe I'm entitled to see you.
Why are you humiliating me like this?
She may look innocent,
but she can be vicious when she wants to.
She has a lot of scars because of me.
Please take good care of my daughter,
that's what I wanted to tell you.
I don't think you need to worry about your daughter.
I'll make sure that she is always loved.
Thank you.
You can go.
If you were going to meet my mom, you should've told me.
I did tell you.
I told you that I was meeting a very beautiful woman.
This is so humiliating.
Showing you this messed up family of mine is humiliating.
You discovered even worse things about me.
I know.
I could've used that as leverage to make you love only me.
You can use that as leverage against me every day,
so stop crying.
Seo Yi Soo cries way too often.
I cried the most when you broke up with me.
I also cried the most when I broke up with you.
Then why did you do it?
'Cause I love you, stupid.
Any progress?
What progress?
No matter what I do, it doesn't make any difference.
If you don't want to get divorced, seduce her again.
Love is faster than forgiveness.
I need to see her to actually seduce her!
I tried all night and it didn't work!
Thirty phone calls, fifty messages!
What did she say?
She said she was going to report me, told me to stop calling.
She even moved hotels, so I have no way to see her now!
There is one way to see her.
What's that?
Have Yoon and Me Ah Ri marry tomorrow,
then you can see her.
Are you playing this down just because you're in a romantic comedy?
A few days ago Yoon stopped by our house and his mouth was all bloodied.
He must've gotten hit by Tae San.
So what marriage-
Welcome.
Me Ah Ri and Yoon are going to come.
I called them here 'cause I need to tell them something.
Take away your expensive cups.
I'm no longer going to oppose you two.
Really?
But if you two separate in a few months, or a year or two,
I refuse to see you sobbing and crying.
If you do break up,
I'll lose both of you for real.
So if you two are really going to do this,
you might as well get married.
I agree with San.
As soon as you can.
Will you be able to-
I'll do it.
How fast does it need to be?
One month?
Two weeks?
One week?
Are you serious?
Without such resolve,
how do you think I was able to hold her back from going to America?
Me Ah Ri may object to it.
Right, what's so great about becoming a married woman?
I'm fine!
I don't object!
It's like a dream...
to me.
Thanks.
I won't disappoint you.
Oppa, are you serious?
Can I really get married to Yoon-oppa?
Yes.
Oppa, get up.
We need to reserve a wedding hall, look at dresses,
there's so much we need to do!
Let's hurry and go, we need to do everything we can!
I'm going.
Let's go.
What is it?
Is this what you really wanted or was it all a plan?
If it was a plan, it was a complete failure.
Are you really giving them your permission?
Didn't you see them agree in less than one second?
What can I do when they feel that way?
I've lost.
You didn't lose, you won.
How?
I don't know.
But in these situations, that's just what you're supposed to say.
I'm going to destroy you.
Please love Do Jin!
Where are you going?
The New York Stock Exchange is affected by the economic crisis in Spain.
Dow has dropped 120 points
As a result, Spain's recession...
If anyone saw you, they'd think you were being forced into this marriage.
It happened all so sudden,
it feels weird, like it's all a dream.
I imagined getting married to you a lot,
but this is for real.
Is there a wedding you've dreamed of?
'Cause we may not be able to...
No.
My dream has always been of you becoming my husband.
I'll make sure you never regret it.
I'll be a good husband.
Every day, I'll give my thanks.
The lease for Woori Bank's Nonhyeon Branch expires this month.
I believe they'd like an extension.
But?
The prices have risen.
Just do it.
Next.
Yes.
22-7, these are the contracts for the third and fourth floor.
The building where the contractors are in the first and second floor?
Is there anything in particular I should know?
No.
They agreed to all the conditions.
Did you tell him I was here?
He threatened me.
I apologize.
If you act like this, I won't be able to work with you.
We'll continue this later in the afternoon.
Yes.
Me Ah Ri is getting married.
Are you kidding me?
No, it's true.
Tae San gave her his permission.
Fine.
Let's say that's true.
So?
Is that why you interrupted my business?
What's so important about my ex-husband's friend's little sister getting married?
Do you know just how important that report was?
Me Ah Ri is getting married,
what could be more important than that?
Just tell me.
About what?
Should we do it together or separately?
We need to get her a wedding present.
She was once your spy, after all.
Guess you can just use and throw away both your spy and your husband.
What?
Look here, ex-wife,
in terms of timing, they decided to get married before we got the divorce.
So that means we can give them a present together, right?
What do you think?
Are you sure it was before the divorce?
I submitted the divorce papers today, as soon as the clock struck nine.
Today's a Saturday.
Do you think a person like me can't do it because it's a Saturday?
Do you know how much I pay in taxes?
Who did it?
You think I went there myself?
My lawyer did it for me.
Yoon told me that documents for a mutual consent divorce couldn't be
submitted by a lawyer.
Fine, I went myself.
He said the couple had to go together.
That's just common sense,
to a man whose wife has suggested divorce ten thousand times.
What is it you want to say?
Are you happy now that you've thrown me away?
For the most part.
I'm not.
I'm not happy.
Just a few days ago you were my woman.
But over the span of a few days,
you've become a woman I wish was mine.
If you're done, go.
One more thing.
You've suffered a lot loving a guy like me.
I'm sorry for that.
Don't be happy for the most part,
be truly happy, Park Min Sook.
Did you see the ethics teacher's boyfriend?
I saw him in front of the school.
But he looked really familiar.
What does the punk do?
Punk?
He's chic and really good-looking.
How do you know?
Did you see him too?
My mom bought it for me!
Who's your mom, then?
You want to get hit!
Hey, stand still!
Isn't that Yoo Sung Jae?
Aren't those Woo Hyun High School uniforms?
Please!
Stand straight!
Four against one, they're just a bunch of punks.
But getting involved in that fight...
...isn't a good idea.
Are you Colin's guardian?
Yes, this is the police station.
Those bastards started the fight!
You guys jumped me first!
Those are all lies and these guys...
...helped me while they were passing by.
He's right, I'm a witness.
Did you win or lose?
Looks like you won.
That's our homeroom teacher's boyfriend.
What?
Sorry.
They said our guardians had to come.
These are my friends.
This is Dong Hyub, and Sang Hyun.
Why are you with these kids?
You've seen how those uncles of yours have made my life hard, haven't you?
Dad!
My son!
What happened to your face?
Which one of you bastards made my son's face like this?
Dad, he did.
Is it you?
Is it you?
Father...
A student should be studying,
do you know who I am?
Who did that to your face?
He did.
What are you going to do?
What did you just do?
You want to die?
Please, calm down.
An adult can't hit a child.
Who are you?
Are you that kid's dad?
I'm his friend's dad.
Even I've never laid a hand on him, and that goes for his friends as well.
If you consider your child precious,
then you should know that others think the same of their own.
How dare you lay a hand on him?
I'll break that wrist of yours.
Sorry, but whose guardian are you?
Both of them.
Are the three of you friends?
Yes.
Why did you help us?
It's not like we've had a good relationship.
I'm an adult,
and you kids are still young enough to need guidance.
Thank you.
I have an engagement so I'll be going.
And you two, quit smoking!
Right.
Police station?
Now it really feels like I have a son.
Is that a problem that should be left to their homeroom teacher?
What did you say?
Did Colin get into trouble?
It all turned out well.
You heard about Me Ah Ri getting married, right?
Aren't you envious?
Rather than envious...
so cold...
it's surprising.
Marriage shouldn't be taken lightly.
Knowing everything about marriage and yet still pushing for it,
Yoon is the one who should be commended.
Lawyer Yoon must love Me Ah Ri a lot.
Do you get married because you love someone?
I love Seo Yi Soo a lot too, then we should also-
One couple is getting divorced, another getting married,
both divorce and marriage are done so that people can be happy,
but the paths are so different.
Are you worried about Jung Rok's wife?
Don't worry, that couple won't separate.
